name: Heliod
description: Heliod is the god of the sun of Theros, the foremost god of its humans, who blesses the Champion of the Sun.

description_citations.text: "Ajani, Mentor of Heroes" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Dec 2014.
"Kruphix's Insight" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Jun 2014.

summary.text: Heliod is the god of the sun of Theros, the foremost god of its humans, who blesses the Champion of the Sun.

bio.text: Kruphix says that Heliod was not always the sun god and that gods depend on mortals believing they are unchanging.

citations.text: "Kruphix's Insight" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Jun 2014.

bio.text: He murders his champion Elspeth with her own weapon, Godsend, claiming a champion cannot know more than her god.

citations.text: "Kruphix's Insight" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Jun 2014.

bio.text: He is a sworn enemy of Erebos, who imprisons him after Elspeth tricks him into a second confrontation.

citations.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 2: Dirty Laundry
citations.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 2: Dirty Laundry" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Mar 2022.

bio.text: He once invited young Gideon to become his champion.
During the Phyrexian invasion, Ajani converts the gods of Theros in Heliod's temple, and Heliod becomes a corrupted god.

timeline.summary: Zosimos, walking by the woods, is overtaken by worry that he will never gain the glory and favor of the gods like other heroes.
timeline.quote: What if he died having never gained the favor of the gods?

citation.text: "The Path or the Horizon" by Adam Lee. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 May 2014.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Heliod snatches Godsend from Elspeth and murders her with it, claiming a champion cannot know more than her god.
timeline.quote: And then he murdered her, his own champion, with her own weapon.

citation.text: "Kruphix's Insight" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Jun 2014.

timeline.summary: Kruphix tells Kydele that the gods are beliefs that took form in Nyx, that Heliod was not always the sun god and that gods depend on mortals believing they are unchanging.
timeline.quote: The gods are beliefs that took form within the fabric of Nyx.

citation.text: "Kruphix's Insight" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Jun 2014.

timeline.summary: Gideon recalls Heliod and the death of his Irregulars, doubting he can trust a god again.
timeline.quote: The mission Heliod had set before him had led to the death of Gideon's closest friends, his Irregulars.

citation.text: "Trust" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Apr 2017.

timeline.summary: In a flashback, Heliod runs Elspeth through with Godsend and orders Ajani to carry her to Erebos.
timeline.quote: "Carry her back to the mortal realm, leonin. Deliver her to Erebos,"

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 1: Homecoming
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 1: Homecoming" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: In the memory, Elspeth tells Ajani how she tricked Heliod into a second confrontation, letting Erebos imprison him.
timeline.quote: she gave Erebos, God of the Dead, an opportunity to imprison Heliod.

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 2: Dirty Laundry
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 2: Dirty Laundry" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Elspeth sees Ajani in Heliod's temple, converting gods and forcing a priestess to drink Phyrexian oil.
timeline.quote: He's already changed three of them.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 6: The Last to Leave
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 6: The Last to Leave" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Angels pour through the portal to Theros and protect its people, shielding Kaya as she kills the corrupted god Heliod.
timeline.quote: When at last she drives a dagger into his throat

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 9: The Old Sins of New Phyrexia
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 9: The Old Sins of New Phyrexia" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Kytheon kills the other inmates with his magic to defeat Heliod and wins his freedom.
timeline.quote: Kytheon succeeded, but only because his magic killed the other inmates by siphoning their lifeforce to strengthen him.

citation.text: "The Legends of Reality Fracture" by Meris Mullaley, Christopher Stuart-Reckling, K. Arsenault Rivera, DK Billins. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Heliod murders Elspeth with her own weapon.
timeline.quote: Heliod appeared and used her weapon to murder Elspeth

citation.text: "Ajani Goldmane", section "Journey to Theros". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ajani reveals Heliod's murder in Meletis and spreads the message that gods are creations of belief; he earns his place among Theros's leonin.
timeline.quote: With that, he earned his place amongst the leonin of Theros.

citation.text: "Ajani Goldmane", section "Journey to Theros". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ajani compleats at least three of Theros's gods, including Heliod.
timeline.quote: He succeeded in compleating at least three of Theros's gods, including Heliod

citation.text: "Ajani Goldmane", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kaya kills Heliod and Ajani faces off with her.
timeline.quote: After Kaya Cassir appeared on Theros and killed Heliod

citation.text: "Ajani Goldmane", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kytheon saves the Kolophon from harpies and cyclopes, defeats the titan of Erebos with Heliod's spear, then throws the spear at Erebos, who kills his irregulars; Kytheon first planeswalks to Bant and becomes Gideon Jura.
timeline.quote: Shocked and shamed by their deaths at his hand, Kytheon then made his first planeswalk to Bant, where he became known as Gideon Jura.

citation.text: "Akros", section "Kytheon Iora". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Heliod takes pity on an archon and gives it a spear in exchange for the rule of law in the wildest places.
timeline.quote: Heliod took pity on the archon and gave it a spear almost as radiant as his own

citation.text: "Archon", section "Archon of Falling Stars". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Elspeth, helped by Daxos, slays Polukranos, becoming Heliod's champion.
timeline.quote: Elspeth engaged the hydra with the help of Daxos and succeeded where many had failed, slaying it

citation.text: "Daxos", section "Godsend". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Elevated to demigod, Daxos is reformed by Heliod to destroy signs of other divinities in Meletis.
timeline.quote: He was reformed by Heliod with the task of destroying every sign of other divinities in Meletis

citation.text: "Daxos", section "Demigod". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Elspeth flees Heliod with the Sword of Chaos, which he later remakes into Godsend.
timeline.quote: he transformed the blade into a spear he dubbed Godsend

citation.text: "Elspeth Tirel", section "Theros". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Heliod turns against Elspeth, believing she was part of Xenagos's plan.
timeline.quote: Heliod was wroth, believing she was implicit in Xenagos's plan, and sought to destroy her.

citation.text: "Elspeth Tirel", section "The Great Revel". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Heliod fatally wounds Elspeth with her own weapon.
timeline.quote: using her weapon fatally wounded Elspeth

citation.text: "Elspeth Tirel", section "Journey into Nyx". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: With Shadowspear acknowledged as the true Khrusor, Heliod yields and Erebos imprisons him in the Underworld.
timeline.quote: The God of the Sun was forced to yield and Erebos imprisoned him in the Underworld forever.

citation.text: "Elspeth Tirel", section "Beyond death". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After Elspeth slays Xenagos, Heliod has Daxos remove traces of other gods from Meletis; the gods go to war, rifts open to the Underworld, and Erebos neglects the souls under his charge out of hatred of Heliod.
timeline.quote: He hated Heliod most of all, and in his rage, he neglected to keep a tight grip on the souls under his purview.

citation.text: "Erebos", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: When Elspeth defeats Heliod, Erebos places him beneath a boulder in the Underworld and gives Elspeth his gratitude and safe passage home.
timeline.quote: Erebos took the defeated sun god and placed him beneath a giant boulder in the Underworld

citation.text: "Erebos", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In the revised origin, Kytheon throws Heliod's spear at Erebos, who redirects it and kills all his irregulars; ashamed, he makes his first planeswalk to Bant and becomes Gideon.
timeline.quote: Erebos easily changed the course of the spear, killing all the irregulars.

citation.text: "Gideon Jura", section "Revised Origin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Heliod arms Kytheon and sends him after a Titan sent rampaging by Erebos, leading to his companions' deaths and his ascension as a planeswalker.
timeline.quote: It was Heliod who armed Kytheon (later known as Gideon ) and sent him after a Titan that Erebos had sent rampaging across Theros.

citation.text: "Heliod", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Heliod's desire for praise brings him into savage conflict with Purphoros; Purphoros' blade falls and is taken by Elspeth.
timeline.quote: fell from the heavens and was taken by a frightened Elspeth

citation.text: "Heliod", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Heliod tries to burn Elspeth alive for her sword, fails, and makes her his champion, converting the blade into the spear Godsend.
timeline.quote: he saw fit to make her his "champion" and converted the weapon into a spear called Godsend .

citation.text: "Heliod", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Heliod blames Elspeth for Xenagos' apotheosis and tries unsuccessfully to kill her.
timeline.quote: Heliod was quick to blame Elspeth and once again tried to kill her, but failed.

citation.text: "Heliod", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After Elspeth's battle with Xenagos in Nyx, Heliod takes Godsend and stabs her, murdering her while taunting her.
timeline.quote: taking Godsend away from her and stabbing her with it

citation.text: "Heliod", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Heliod gives Elspeth's corpse to Ajani Goldmane and departs.
timeline.quote: He gave her corpse to Ajani Goldmane

citation.text: "Heliod", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Heliod resurrects Daxos as a demigod at great cost while seeking to become sole god.
timeline.quote: Heliod sought to become the sole god of the pantheon.

citation.text: "Heliod", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Elspeth fights Heliod at the borders of the Underworld and shatters his spear; Erebos chains Heliod beneath a boulder.
timeline.quote: chained Heliod into the Underworld beneath a giant boulder.

citation.text: "Heliod", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Heliod is compleated when the Chrome Host compleates his followers.
timeline.quote: were still able to claim Heliod by compleating his followers

citation.text: "Heliod", section "March of the Machine". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kaya Cassir kills the compleated Heliod and his body fades away.
timeline.quote: The compleated god was later killed by Kaya Cassir during the invasion's waning moments

citation.text: "Heliod", section "March of the Machine". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Afraid of her power, Heliod kills Elspeth.
timeline.quote: Afraid of her power, Heliod kills Elspeth.

citation.text: "Journey into Nyx", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kaya kills the compleated Heliod by climbing him and cutting his throat.
timeline.quote: the compleated Heliod was distracted enough to be killed by Kaya, who climbed him and cut his throat

citation.text: "Kaya Cassir", section "March of the Machine". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: As war breaks out among the gods, Erebos is consumed by hatred of Heliod and begins to lose control of his realm's souls.
timeline.quote: Erebos was consumed by his hatred of Heliod

citation.text: "Klothys", section "Return to the mortal world". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kruphix and his oracle observed Xenagos's defeat by Elspeth and Ajani and Heliod's later betrayal of Elspeth.
timeline.quote: He and his oracle observed the defeat of Xenagos by Elspeth and Ajani

citation.text: "Kruphix", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Phyrexians exploit belief on Theros, compleating followers and Heliod.
timeline.quote: it is known that Heliod was compleated and Ephara was not

citation.text: "List of deities", section "Theros". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Heliod makes the oracle Daxos his champion and orders him to remove the other gods from Meletis; the gods go to war.
timeline.quote: he pulled the soul of the oracle Daxos and transformed him into his champion in the mortal realm

citation.text: "Meletis", section "Beyond Death". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Heliod has died, leaving it unclear whether his solstice holiday is still celebrated.
timeline.quote: whether this holiday is still celebrated after Heliod's death is unknown.

citation.text: "Mortal Realm", section "Meletian calendar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kaya kills the distracted compleated Heliod after a Capennan counter-invasion of Theros.
timeline.quote: the compleated Heliod was distracted enough to be killed by Kaya Cassir

citation.text: "New Phyrexian Invasion", section "Theros". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nylea forgives Elspeth, but Heliod kills Elspeth with Godsend.
timeline.quote: Heliod killed Elspeth with her weapon, Godsend

citation.text: "Nylea", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Penthikos reports to the king of Akros, who sentences him to be chained to the rocks.
timeline.quote: And so he was chained to the rocks , to die in the sun of Heliod .

citation.text: "Penthikos", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Purphoros creates the Sword of Chaos to challenge Heliod; their battle disrupts the resting place of Polukranos, who rampages until Heliod and Nylea seal him.
timeline.quote: Purphoros once created the Sword of Chaos to challenge the sun god Heliod .

citation.text: "Purphoros", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: When Heliod has Daxos purge Meletis of other gods' influence, Purphoros and the others summon champions from the Underworld, Purphoros choosing Anax.
timeline.quote: Purphoros’s champion was Anax , former king of Akros .

citation.text: "Purphoros", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Heliod destroys Olantin with a spear thrown from Nyx after the Triarchy conjures a false sun.
timeline.quote: Heliod hurled his spear down from Nyx, destroying Olantin in a single stroke.

citation.text: "Siren Sea", section "Locations of the Siren Sea". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Elspeth kills a deadly hydra in a bitter battle, winning Heliod's notice.
timeline.quote: After a bitter battle, she emerges the victor.

citation.text: "Theros", section "Elspeth". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Heliod, noticing her feat, strives to make Elspeth his champion.
timeline.quote: Heliod, taking notice of her feat, now strives to make Elspeth his champion.

citation.text: "Theros", section "Elspeth". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Xenagos ascends to godhood through the forced worship of a Great Revel after the siege of Akros, and Elspeth is scapegoated and exiled.
timeline.quote: Using the forced worhsip of mortal revelers, Xenagos managed to ascend to godhood.

citation.text: "Theros (plane)", section "The rise and fall of Xenagos". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Elspeth offers her life for Daxos; Erebos accepts and Heliod fatally wounds his former champion.
timeline.quote: Elspeth offered her life in trade for her lover Daxos .

citation.text: "Theros (plane)", section "The rise and fall of Xenagos". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Heliod makes Daxos his champion to purge the other gods from Meletis, starting a war of the gods and opening rifts to the Underworld.
timeline.quote: the gods were at war

citation.text: "Theros (plane)", section "War of the gods". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Elspeth, empowered by Ashiok, escapes the Underworld to assassinate Heliod.
timeline.quote: Elspeth became empowered by Ashiok , who equipped her with a weapon created from her past traumas

citation.text: "Theros (plane)", section "War of the gods". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Elspeth's Shadowspear is acknowledged as the true Khrusor, Heliod's spear shatters, and Erebos imprisons Heliod in the Underworld forever.
timeline.quote: Erebos imprisoned him in the Underworld forever

citation.text: "Theros (plane)", section "War of the gods". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kaya Cassir kills the distracted compleated Heliod as New Capenna's angels counter-invade.
timeline.quote: the compleated Heliod was distracted enough to be killed by Kaya Cassir

citation.text: "Theros (plane)", section "Phyrexian invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The gods are at war and bring their champions to fight.
timeline.quote: The Gods are at war, and they bring their champions to fight.

citation.text: "Theros Beyond Death", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Elspeth breaks free and defeats Heliod with a weapon created from her past traumas.
timeline.quote: Elspeth breaks free and defeats Heliod with a weapon created from her past traumas .

citation.text: "Theros Beyond Death", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Heliod kills Elspeth Tirel in Nyx.
timeline.quote: Heliod kills Elspeth with her weapon.

citation.text: "Timeline", section "The Mending Era (4500 AR to 4562 AR)". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Elspeth Tirel defeats Heliod and escapes the Underworld.
timeline.quote: Elspeth Tirel defeats Heliod and escapes the Underworld .

citation.text: "Timeline", section "After the War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kaya Cassir kills the compleated Heliod.
timeline.quote: Heliod is killed by Kaya Cassir .

citation.text: "Timeline", section "The New Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Klothys traps Heliod in the Underworld as punishment for his hubris.
timeline.quote: Following the events of Theros Beyond Death , Heliod became trapped in the Underworld by Klothys as punishment for his hubris.

citation.text: "Underworld", section "Gods". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Fearing replacement, Heliod strikes Elspeth down and casts her into the Underworld.
timeline.quote: Fearful, he struck her down in her moment of triumph, casting her into the Underworld to be forgotten.

citation.text: "War of the Gods", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Heliod transforms Daxos into his Champion and orders him to remove all trace of the other gods from Meletis.
timeline.quote: Daxos was instructed to remove all trace of the other gods from the great city of Meletis

citation.text: "War of the Gods", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Elspeth awakens with the Shadowspear and heads for a hidden exit, gathering followers and claiming Heliod's spear is the fake.
timeline.quote: Her believers gave her weapon power, and simultaneously weakened Heliod.

citation.text: "War of the Gods", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Heliod's spear shatters against the Shadowspear and the onlookers' belief makes Elspeth's lie true; Heliod yields.
timeline.quote: Staring down the point of a spear that was no longer his, Heliod yielded.

citation.text: "War of the Gods", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Erebos places the defeated Heliod beneath a boulder and gives Elspeth safe passage back to the mortal realm.
timeline.quote: Erebos simply took the defeated sun god and placed him beneath a giant boulder

citation.text: "War of the Gods", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Zoe meets an alseid of Heliod who explains how human warriors massacre her flocks.
timeline.quote: It seemed to Zoe that all of nature was harmed by humans.

citation.text: "Zoe", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
